note: Sample recalls: fictional, for the Remedy demo only. Brightline Home and Fernway Home are fictional sample firms, and BH-2026-01 and FW-2026-01 are not CPSC recall numbers. Fernway sells the same sample charger under its own name, so its recall can show the hash check that runs across firms. Kept apart from recalls.json, so no CPSC statistic, explorer count or benchmark ever includes them. Photos: one real laptop charger before and after its cord was cut, by Dmitry G on Wikimedia Commons (public domain, PD-self); see public/samples/charger/CREDITS.json. The charger's maker has not recalled it, and its brand marks and label text were removed for the demo.

recalls.title: Brightline Home recalls 65W laptop chargers (sample recall)
recalls.hazard: The charger's cord can overheat where it meets the case, posing a fire hazard.
recalls.remedyText: Stop using the charger and cut the power cord where it meets the charger case. Send one photo of the cut cord with the charger for a full refund of $34.99.

recalls.description: This sample recall involves Brightline 65W laptop chargers, black, with a fixed power cord. Model BLC-6520, UPC 400000652009 and the month the charger was made are printed on a label on the bottom of the charger. The recalled chargers were manufactured from October 2025 through February 2026. Brightline Home is a fictional sample firm, and this recall is fictional: its model number is made up, and its UPC starts with 4, the number kept for a store's own in-store codes, so no retail product carries it.
